family_resolutions.signature: Volunteers give pairs self-contained shared openings, sometimes initial reciprocal turns, while retaining the routine. Removing unequal prior context should improve entry and useful speech after pairing. Requires comparable accessible prompts and feasible preparation; attendance and public labels remain optional.
family_resolutions.reason: Agreed family preserved. All eleven openings reset shared context and test entry/usefulness; timing and familiarity strata refine the archived entry mechanism.

family_resolutions.signature: Volunteers place one next-session date and task prominently on existing paper, distribute it at sessions and sometimes recap it. Temporal identification should reduce stale-task answers and clarification work. Requires timely task selection, understandable dates and offline copies; earlier, blank and receipt-coded answers bound the account.
family_resolutions.reason: The eleven members share single-task temporal identification. H3-F03 supplies the intervention and H3-F06 the information-confusion investigation. Reusable layout alone is not H3-F04 topic-pack reuse. Advance acquisition across missing handoffs is assessed separately in C03.

family_resolutions.signature: Volunteers prepublish multiple independent tasks indexed by future dates; learners retain the paper and select the relevant task after absences without another weekly handoff. family_resolutions.reason: All four members supply future information before a possible missed handoff. That acquisition path differs from handing out one next task or volunteers reusing packs; novelty is local to the incomplete archive, not the number or shape of cards. P009 tests recovery with hypothetical return dates. Outcomes remain untested.

family_resolutions.signature: Volunteers combine self-contained prompts, optional supports, balanced roles or timed turns and sometimes reversible quick pairing. These additive operations target entry delay and unequal speaking opportunity; faster starts or more speech must also improve reported usefulness. Assumes acceptable prompts and affordable coordination within the session.
family_resolutions.reason: Agreed four-member bundle retained. No member asserts an isolated interaction beyond the archived components. C12 may add adaptive feedback, but its distinct benefit is not specified adequately.

family_resolutions.signature: Partners alternately supply content unknown to the other, using complementary scenario sheets or private personal/invented examples; listeners discover it, sometimes retell it, and roles reverse. Reciprocal informational dependence should ease entry and support useful speech versus shared content. Assumes comfortable accessible subjects and feasible materials.
family_resolutions.reason: Agreed three-member family retained. Each speaker becomes a needed source; allocated turns and shared fresh prompts alone do not create that dependence. Personal versus split-sheet content is compatible with the same path.

family_resolutions.signature: Participants prepare one enduring invitation for their next attendance, bringing a question or personal material; unprepared arrivals use immediate examples. Removing changing task identity should reduce obsolete-task answers and planning/clarification work while supplying conversation. Requires continued motivation, suitability and sufficient offline access.
family_resolutions.reason: Agreed two-member family and local novelty retained. Stable preparation eliminates version succession rather than improving version selection. P005 adds an unverified pickup dependency; that does not change the shared mechanism.

family_resolutions.signature: At each speaker-role handoff, a fresh scenario and optional supports reset shared context while alternating roles allocate access. Compare cards, roles, both and usual practice for usefulness beyond either component; assume feasible cards and accepted supports.
family_resolutions.reason: Agreed singleton retained. The explicit context-at-handoff interaction is distinct from additive C04 and the other component interactions; effectiveness remains speculative.

family_resolutions.signature: Partners explain a dated paper task, check the explanation against its card/example and correct mismatches. family_resolutions.reason: All three members share version-anchored peer checking. P008 additionally observes later recall, without contradicting the common path. H3-F03 supplies dated paper and recap; H3-F06 does not supply interpretation checking or the claimed interaction. Workload logging alone does not make it an equivalent archive mechanism.

family_resolutions.signature: Pairs combine fresh shared context with privately chosen language scaffolds. Compare baseline, restart, scaffold and both; require optional reusable supports within existing resources.
family_resolutions.reason: Agreed singleton retained. The context-by-support interaction has a distinct component-controlled prediction; success remains untested.

family_resolutions.signature: Pairs cross private scaffolds with protected reciprocal turns: scaffolds make available airtime useful and turns ensure opportunities to use them. Compare scaffold-only, turns-only, combined and incumbent conditions for gains beyond summed separate gains and lower imbalance; require useful voluntary supports and feasible timing.
family_resolutions.reason: Agreed singleton retained. This support-by-airtime prediction differs from context-by-support and context-at-role-handoff interactions.

family_resolutions.signature: Pairs independently vary fresh/familiar scenarios and optional/existing supports. Context should affect first-exchange latency; support should improve usefulness with fresh context held fixed. Comparable scenarios, private choices and feasible observation are required.
family_resolutions.reason: Agreed singleton retained. The independent-effects discriminator differs from interaction claims and sharpens the archived opportunity-versus-suitability question.
